content: st.cache_data copies return value (safe for DataFrames), st.cache_resource stores the object by reference and is meant for unserializable global singletons like ML models/DB connections. Pitfalls: using cache_resource on non-thread-safe mutable objects risks cross-user corruption in a multi-user deployment; underscore-prefixed args skip hashing and can cause stale/wrong cache hits; caching live-price DataFrames without a TTL serves stale market data indefinitely.
